name: LongBench-Chat
description: LongBench-Chat is a benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' instruction-following capabilities on very long context inputs ranging from 10,000 to 100,000 tokens, supporting research on long context alignment.
reputation: Widely used in long-context LLM research as one of the standard benchmarks for instruction-following over very long inputs.
notes: Supports evaluation of LLMs on extremely long input sequences; accompanies LongAlign training recipe.
